entities.name: Yūki Ishikawa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yūki Ishikawa  is a Japanese male professional volleyball player from Okazaki City, Aichi Prefecture. He is the captain of the Japan men's national volleyball team, and plays as an outside hitter. At club-level, he currently plays for Sir Susa Vim Perugia at the SuperLega.
